title: jax.numpy.heaviside returns x2 value for NaN input instead of propagating NaN
author: ALinrunrun

comments.author: jakevdp
comments.body: This falls under https://github.com/jax-ml/jax/issues/38651; please note that it may take a while for this to receive attention from the team.

comments.author: CodersAcademy006
comments.body: I can't reproduce this on 0.10.2 / current main: `jnp.heaviside(np.array([np.nan, 0.0, -1.0], np.float32), 1.0)` returns `[nan, 1., 0.]`, matching `numpy.heaviside`. Looking at the implementation, `heaviside` (`jax/_src/numpy/ufuncs.py:3708-3710`) already has an explicit NaN branch — `_where(lax._isnan(x1), x1, x2)` — so a `nan` input propagates `nan` rather than falling through to `x2`. This looks already fixed; it may be closeable. @ALinrunrun could you confirm which jax version you saw the `x2`-instead-of-`nan` behavior on?
